title: Three bandits block the road, blades drawn but no orders given
description: Their captain — leaner, more thoughtful than the rest — raises a hand. He'll talk before he fights.

choices.text: Show them why they should fear you.

onPass.narration: The captain reads the line of you, spits in the dust, and waves his men off the road. One of them leaves his purse behind in the hurry.

onFail.narration: They laugh. Steel rings free of scabbards.

onPass.narration: They step aside, all smiles. The captain even nods you a good evening — thirty gold buys a quiet mile.

onFail.narration: Your purse comes up short. They take it as insult.

onPass.narration: Whatever you said worked. They wave you on, almost embarrassed — and the captain points out the ford that saves you half a day's walk.
